headline: Burn pECX from BitWindow — and do it before the Alphanet stops.
message: The burn is implemented in BitWindow: on Alphanet, the Receive page carries a Burn Transaction card. Send more than 1,000 pECX to the Bitcoin eater address, and the wallet puts its own first address in the OP_RETURN — that address receives 1/100 of what you burn as real ECX at mainnet, rounded up. The Alphanet is being retired this week, so anyone holding pECX there has to act.

expect.note: Balances do not carry over from alpha to beta: the betanet is a separate chain that forks Bitcoin at 967,680. Details: /betanet/.

announcement.source_note: Drivechain Talk (Telegram, private supergroup) — Paul Sztorc, 14 Sep 2026 01:22 UTC, confirmed by him at 01:25 UTC ("Yes that's the one"); message ids 250407, 250411, 250412. Ratio and minimum were restated in the same group on 15 Sep ("confirmed that you will get 10 ECX for every 1000 alpha pECX, as long as you burn at least 1000"), and the numbers below were then verified against the implementation itself.
announcement.quote: 1. Send to 1BitcoinEaterDontSendxxx  2. Add a 0-valued op return, to an address A that you have the key for. The coins will go to address A. As long as there is more than the threshold (1000).

published_override.reason: Hand-published on the owner's instruction from the Telegram exports of Drivechain Talk. The source is the project lead in the project's own group plus the wallet implementation, not an official-domain document, so the automated allowlist would refuse it.

spec.network: pECX on the ECX Alphanet — the burn card only exists on Alphanet
spec.ratio: 1/100 of what you burn, rounded up to a whole ECX satoshi: 1,000 → 10 ECX, 1,013 → 10.13 ECX
spec.minimum: Strictly more than 1,000 pECX. Exactly 1,000 is rejected.
spec.deadline: Before the betanet fork — BTC block 967,680, expected Saturday 19 September 2026 at about 08:00 UTC. The alphanet stops being mined at that fork.
spec.mainnet: ECX mainnet ~31 October 2026 (BTC block ~973,728). The betanet forked earlier, at BTC block 967,680 on 19 September 2026 — see /betanet/.
spec.payout: The OP_RETURN carries the wallet's own first address, and the ECX credit lands there. BitWindow fills it in — you do not type an address.
spec.source_note: Verified against the implementation: ECXBurnAddress, ECXBurnMinimumSats = 100,000,000,000 sat and ECXCreditSats = ceil(burn/100) in sidechain-orchestrator/wallet/ecx_burn.go. No official document exists.

guide.title: Update BitWindow, and be on Alphanet
guide.detail: The burn is new, so an older build does not have it — update from inside the app (LayerTwo ships through Sparkle, not GitHub releases). The card only exists on Alphanet; on any other network it is not shown at all.

guide.title: Go to Wallet → Receive, with an Electrum wallet selected and unlocked
guide.detail: It must be a wallet holding its own private key: BitWindow refuses Core wallets, watch-only wallets and hardware wallets — "This wallet cannot sign this burn. Select a software wallet with its private key." The Burn Transaction card sits below the receive QR.

guide.title: Enter the amount, read the two panels, press Burn Transaction
guide.detail: Up to 8 decimals, and it must exceed 1,000. BitWindow then shows Alphanet → Real ECX (what you give up, what you get) and the outputs: your amount to the eater address, plus a 0-value OP_RETURN carrying your wallet's first address. Press Burn Transaction, and keep the txid it returns — that is your proof of burn.

warnings: It cannot be undone. The eater address has no private key, by design — those pECX are gone, and what comes back is the credit at mainnet, nothing else.
1,000 is not enough. The threshold is exclusive: burning exactly 1,000 gets you nothing, and there is no topping up afterwards.

Your ECX is credited to your wallet's first address — you never type a payout address. If you cannot sign for that address later you cannot reach the ECX, so don't burn from a wallet you are about to throw away.
The Alphanet is being retired this week. Anything left on it after it stops is not redeemable.
This came out of a Telegram chat; there is still no official specification document. Ask before moving anything you would miss.
Nobody legitimate needs your seed phrase or private key to help you redeem. Anyone who asks is robbing you.
